about: Rule × source cases that pin Rerail's relational semantics to upstream ast-grep 0.45.3. Each case runs through the ast-grep CLI and through Rerail's kernel (stateless and anchor-indexed workspace), and the match sets must agree. The CLI rejects a top-level rule without a node kind (e.g. regex-only), so every rule names a kind or pattern. precedes/follows reach siblings only; anonymous tokens are children and siblings, and only regex (or a pattern of the token) names them; one metavariable environment threads through relations; in contextual patterns the selector node alone is matched and the context only guides parsing.
